articles.title: Bitcoin gives back Monday's gain as Clarity Act odds fade on Polymarket
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell 1.7% since midnight UTC to $76,862, unwinding a late Monday rally as Polymarket odds on the Clarity Act becoming law this year halved overnight.

articles.title: U.S. House panel shares crypto tax bill ahead of hearing later this week
articles.snippet: The House Ways and Means Committee published a crypto tax bill addressing de minimis transactions, staking and other issues for which the industry's clamored for policies.

articles.title: Stablecoin growth could boost dollar dominance, US Treasury demand: BoE official
articles.snippet: A Bank of England policy maker said digital dollars could expand access to the US currency while turning stablecoin issuers into bigger buyers of government debt.

articles.title: USDT payments feature in Polish energy giant’s failed $230M oil deal: FT
articles.snippet: Tether’s USDT stablecoin was part of a failed oil trade that reportedly cost a Polish energy giant $230 million in late 2023.

articles.title: Democrats push back on GOP’s ‘final’ CLARITY offer with counterproposal: Politico
articles.snippet: Some Democrats remain dissatisfied with the bill’s crypto ethics provisions and will be sending a counterproposal just hours before a key procedural vote.
